authenticity_review: The image exhibits high-quality rendering for the koala and mushrooms, with good texture detail and anatomical correctness for the main subject. However, significant fusion artifacts are present in the cat stacks. On the left, the middle and bottom cats merge into an indistinct mass of blue fur where individual limbs and torsos cannot be separated. The top-right cat also shows structural ambiguity, appearing to float or blend into the cat below without clear grounding. These fusion issues reduce the overall authenticity score despite the strong performance of other elements.
